headline: US Treasury sanctions Chandigarh couple + companies for false-flag network aiding Iran's shadow fleet (Operation Economic Outcast)'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT -- US Treasury, primary source] Treasury designated India-based Suniel Kumar Sharma and his wife Jaspreet Preeti Shahid (Chandigarh) plus companies Eswatini Maritime Affairs and International Ship Registry PTE. Ltd.
sources: US Department of the Treasury / OFAC press release 'Operation Economic Outcast Targets Global Maritime Fraud Network Supporting Iranian Regime' + Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on X, Nov 4, 2026
fault_line: Sanctions that strangle the regime's oil money -- or paperwork that punishes ordinary Iranians while the shadow fleet keeps sailing?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- US Treasury, primary source] Treasury designated India-based Suniel Kumar Sharma and his wife Jaspreet Preeti Shahid (Chandigarh) plus companies Eswatini Maritime Affairs and International Ship Registry PTE. Ltd. (Singapore), Oceaniek Technologies India and Aryavart Ship Management, and Turkiye-based Fugo Ground Services Inc., under E.O. 13902. [ATTRIBUTED ALLEGATION -- Treasury] The couple ran a maritime fraud network since at least 2014, impersonating flagging authorities (Dominica attempt, 2014) and running fake registries purporting to belong to Aruba, Nicaragua, Sint Maarten, Guyana, Eswatini, Laos, giving false flags/certificates to vessels carrying Iranian petroleum, including vessels operating for the Iranian military and its proxies. OFAC also issued a new false-flag alert to the shipping industry. Bessent: 'under Operation Economic Outcast, you are either with us or against us.' Treasury notes the Apr 22, 2026 US seizure of the MAJESTIC X, a false-Guyana-flag vessel carrying Iranian oil. Operation Economic Outcast launched Aug 24, 2026.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct publisher families: US Treasury/OFAC (T1 official, primary source) + Times of India (T3, liveblog mention of the sanctions action). Times Now, Financial Express, Hindu BusinessLine, Indian Express, Rediff, FirstPost relay the same Treasury release but carry NO declared tier in the source registry, so they are reported with attribution and do NOT count toward corroboration. No Reuters/AP/AFP wire copy found in-window.
sections.what_disputed: No denial or response from Sharma/Shahid or the named companies found in-window; the named entities have not been shown to have responded. UANI's Nov 2 'ghost fleet' reporting (NY Post/Fox) is a separate, earlier item: at least 9 small tankers evaded the blockade since mid-July, incl. SOGL (500,000 bbl LPG to China via Malaysia EOPL) -- it corroborates the evasion pattern, not this designation.
sections.why_matters: The fake-flag factory: two people in Chandigarh kept Iran's shadow fleet sailing with invented registries -- Treasury just named them. Hard number + reveal frame, proven-set (blockade/shadow-fleet enforcement).
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- US Treasury sanctions Chandigarh couple + companies for false-flag network aiding Iran's shadow fleet (Operation Economic Outcast)
